title: Codemode and smarter model defaults
highlights: Opt-in codemode tool runs JavaScript in an embedded sandbox that can chain, loop over, and parallelize other tool calls in one step
Every provider, including OpenRouter, Bedrock, Grok Build, Copilot, and the Jcode subscription, now defaults to its newest flagship model instead of a stale or merely newest release
The browser bridge checks for updates and installs them automatically
improvements: Gmail drafts and sends support Cc and Bcc recipients
Rendered math copies as LaTeX source, with a hint when TeX is not installed
Ctrl+wheel and trackpad pinch over inline images resize them
Background tasks moved into the background widget, which ranks above stat widgets while tasks need attention
SDK turns that fail transiently are retried automatically
fixes: OpenAI OAuth and API-key logins keep separate model catalogs, so ChatGPT accounts no longer see API-only models
Browser hosts already running a new bridge binary are kept after an update
Compact background rows fit the overview width
